[b]Disclaimer: [/b]Please don't re-upload or re-distribute or edit/trace over my Mod/ Sprites and especially not behind a paywall! It would be very disrespectful of my efforts and work plus it's not a nice thing to do. This was done just so I could practice doing sprites and is meant to be free to enjoy and not for profit. They may not be amazing but I did work hard on them. Please don't add any of my stuff to Mod Packs even with credit. People barely read the credits and it kinda takes away from this mod and the possibility for feedback. If you would like to, for whatever reason, contact me and ask first! I would like to check out the mod first and maybe help push it. I do take commissions as well.This mod should only be available for download here on Nexus and on the stardewvalley mod forum under the username "thatotterthing". Please let me know if you see them floating around anywhere else. 
[b]Content Patcher Version Instructions:
[/b]-make sure you have[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5295] Lemurkats Mr.Ginger mod[/url] and Content patcher installed
-extract to mods folder 
[b]Instructions:
[/b]-make sure you have[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5295] Lemurkats Mr.Ginger mod[/url] installed
-open the mod folder for lemurkats Mister Ginger mod and navigate to the images folder
-replace the 2 Mister Ginger sprite sheets in the folder with my sprites
-all done! (make sure the save a copy of lemurkats sprites elsewhere and move them back to the folder if you want to change back or you can re-download their mod!)

[b][center]**NOTE**This sprite sheet was done with the permission of Lemurkat, the creator of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5295]Mister Ginger mod[/url]﻿﻿, and I claim no credit for the Character or Mr.Ginger Mod itself. I only created these two sprite sheets at the request of  a few who were interested in having Mister GInger done in my stardew-esque style to match my other animal mods. I claim nothing from Lemurkat's Mod and only own these sprite sheets. Please be sure to show Lemurkat some love for all their incredible work and programming! It was a delight to make these and I am glad I was allowed the opportunity. Always remember to ask your modders for permission! They deserve soooo much love and recognition for what they create!
*special thanks to Moonwolf287 for writing up a quick content patcher version
